map.基于遗忘曲线，计算口令训练的最佳重复间隔，规划科学的训练时间表: Based on the forgetting curve, calculate the optimal repetition interval for command training and plan a scientific training schedule
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：Math.exp(-s×hoursAgo÷(reps: Core formulas (by input variables): Math.exp(-s×hoursAgo÷(reps)^0.5); max(0,min(1,retention)); retention×100
map.📖 查看「口令记忆曲线 使用指南」: 📖 View the Command Memory Curve user guide
map.训练新口令时，按遗忘曲线规划 8 级间隔复习表，避免一次练太久却很快遗忘。: When teaching a new command, use the forgetting curve to plan an 8-level spaced review schedule, avoiding one long session that is quickly forgotten.
map.对比幼犬与成年犬的年龄因子差异，调整复习密度——幼犬遗忘慢但学得慢，需更密巩固。: Compare the age-factor difference between puppies and adult dogs to adjust review density — puppies forget more slowly but also learn more slowly, so they need tighter reinforcement.
map.不同难度口令（坐下/装死）分别建模，复杂动作系数更高、衰减更快，应优先排进近期复: Model commands of different difficulty (sit / play dead) separately; complex actions have a higher coefficient and decay faster, so they should be prioritized for near-term review.
map.口令“趴下”已练 5 次 · 中等难度 · 距上次 4 小时: Command "down" practiced 5 times · medium difficulty · 4 hours since the last session
map.遗忘系数 s = 难度系数 0.5 × 年龄因子（6月龄=1.0）= 0.5。当: Forgetting coefficient s = difficulty coefficient 0.5 × age factor (6 months = 1.0) = 0.5. Current retention = e^(−0.5×4/√5) ≈ e^(−0.894) ≈ 40.9%, which falls in the band of memory starting to decay, review as soon as possible. Front part of the 8-level interval table: 5th→6th repetition after about 1 hour (retention ≈80%), 6th→7th after about 4 hours (≈44%), 7th→8th after about 12 hours (≈10%), 8th→9th after about 1 day (≈1%). So beyond 12 hours without review the command is essentially forgotten; schedule several short sessions within the same day.
map.为什么幼犬反而要更密复习？: Why do puppies need more frequent review?
map.年龄因子对幼犬（<6月）取 1.3、成年（>36月）取 1.4，会把 s 放大使: The age factor is 1.3 for puppies (<6 months) and 1.4 for adults (>36 months), which amplifies s and makes the curve steeper and decay faster; but puppies learn more slowly in a single session, so they need short and frequent practice (5–10 minutes each, 2–3 times a day) to offset the rapid forgetting.
map.保留率低于多少必须复习？: Below what retention level must you review?
map.工具以 40% 为警戒线：≥80% 可延长间隔，50–80% 近期复习，30–5: The tool sets 40% as the warning line: ≥80% means the interval can be extended, 50–80% review soon, 30–50% review as soon as possible, <30% retrain. In practice, schedule the next review before retention drops below 40%.
map.记忆保持率 = exp(−衰减系数 × 已过小时数 ÷ √重复次数)，衰减系数: Memory retention = exp(−decay coefficient × hours elapsed ÷ √repetitions); decay coefficient = difficulty factor × age factor (juvenile ×1.3, senior ×1.4), capped at 0.95
map.实测训练记录（仅保存在本机浏览器）: Observed training log (saved only in this browser)
map.记录实际训练日期、环境和成功次数，用真实表现判断是否提高难度；上方曲线仅为教学示: Record date, environment and successes to decide whether to raise difficulty; the curve above is a teaching example, not this dog’s measured memory state.
map.用遗忘曲线教学示例估算复习间隔，并记录训练日期、环境与成功次数，以实测成功率决定: Estimate review intervals from a teaching forgetting-curve example, log date, environment and successes, and use measured success rate to decide on difficulty.
map.记录不足时只把曲线当示例，不据此判定“记忆衰退/必须重新训练”；记录达到 3 次: With too few records, treat the curve only as an example and do not label “memory decline/retrain”; after 3 records, base advice on success rate.
map.不同口令分别记录、分别调整难度，避免用模型系数替代真实训练表现。: Log each command separately and adjust difficulty separately; do not replace real training performance with model coefficients.
map.已练 5 次、中等难度、距上次 4 小时、6 月龄时，模型估算保留率约 40.9: At 5 reps, medium difficulty, 4 h since last session and 6 months age, the model estimates ~40.9% retention—a teaching example, not measured memory. The page logs date, environment and successes locally; e.g. 18/20 (90%) over 3 sessions supports a small difficulty/interval increase; 10/20 (50%) means keep difficulty and review steadily; below 50% reduce difficulty or split steps. Base decisions on measured success rate, not the fixed curve.
map.模型阈值只是示例，不应作为“必须复习/必须重训”的医学判断。请以本地记录的成功率: Model thresholds are examples, not a medical “must review/retrain” judgment. Use logged success rate: ≥80% may raise difficulty/interval slightly, 50–80% keep difficulty, <50% reduce difficulty and split steps; fewer than 3 records are too noisy for advice.
